reply.summary: Aslis is a hired killer who wears a harness of coiled cables that spits jets of burning gas. Contracts are taken in silence and finished before the target hears a single footstep.

feats.scene: Aslis vents the whole harness at a bank vault door and melts the hinges into slag.
A rooftop fall onto a parked truck leaves the harness dented and its wearer on his feet.

reply.summary: Iuvas runs a smuggling empire that sells crates of rifles to rival gangs from behind a ledger and a calm smile. He has never fired a shot himself, and his rivals always find the invoice before the bullet.

feats.scene: Iuvas slaps a late-paying courier hard enough to knock him off his chair.
He walks away from a car that clipped him at a dockside crossing.

reply.summary: Arnte is a seven-foot jailer with pink skin, tripod feet and four whiplike braids tipped in spikes. Taken hostage once, he quietly beat his captors senseless and then waited politely for the cell to be unlocked.

feats.scene: Arnte drives a braid spike through a steel cell door and tears it from its frame.
He shrugs off a collapsing guard tower that buries the rest of the yard.

reply.summary: Tertau is a floppy-eared, dog-faced soldier of a distant ring-bearing order, loyal to a fault and clumsy in every rescue. His glowing ring somehow works better than anyone expects, usually by accident.

feats.scene: Tertau panics and flings a glowing hammer that flattens a parked freighter.
A shimmering bubble from his ring holds while a ship scrapes across it.

reply.summary: Eruau is a fanged, furry recruit pressed into powering a tyrant's doomsday engine alongside his fellow rank. His ring is the only thing the tyrant fears he might misuse.

feats.scene: Eruau feeds his ring into the engine until the cooling towers glow white.
He hangs in the machine's clamps through a full firing cycle and still blinks awake.

reply.summary: Rncor is a small-time ring bearer whose face turns up in rocket-pilot advertisements more often than on any battlefield. Beneath the gag he can still raise a barrier and hurl bright bolts.

feats.scene: Rncor blasts a stalled shuttle off the track with a single bolt.
A glowing shield around him takes a head-on hit from a runaway cargo pod.

reply.summary: Lortacor is a well-meaning bumbler who got his power ring by mistake and stayed a hero by sheer persistence. He pesters bigger teams for a chance to help and sometimes saves the day by luck.

feats.scene: Lortacor wildly swings a ring-made wrecking ball that levels a deserted warehouse.
He sits in a green dome while a rampaging beast stomps on it for an hour.

reply.summary: Tiulrni served as a ring wielder before a long war with a fear-feeding monster scattered his order. Few records of his deeds remain beyond the glow of his old ring.

feats.scene: Tiulrni cuts a stranded freight car in two with a thin ribbon of light.
He rides out a train derailment inside a shimmering shell.

reply.summary: Illan is a ring-carrying fighter from a cartoon universe, quick with a quip and quicker with a glowing shield. He answers every distress call, whether or not anyone asked for him.

feats.scene: Illan hits a giant mind-controlled robot with a bolt that cracks its chest plate.
He is thrown through a stone wall and gets up laughing.

reply.summary: Lacorros is a pint-sized ring bearer who patrols a playground-scaled galaxy of cardboard rockets and juice boxes. His glowing creations are always a little crooked and always just enough.

feats.scene: Lacorros builds a glowing slide and sends a runaway toy truck over a fence with it.
A glowing pillow absorbs a tumble down a flight of stairs.

reply.summary: Osarsor is a shapeshifter who soaks up the blood traits of other creatures and wears them all at once in a lumpy, grinning mass. A laughing poison gave him a manic grin that never fades.

feats.scene: Osarsor sprouts three borrowed arms and tosses a park bench into a tree.
He keeps swinging after a heavy sonic blast rattles the whole park.

reply.summary: Anureslis is a wartime machine soldier built to hunt invaders, with a cheerful voice and an endless internal armoury. Decades later he is still polite, still lethal and still asking friends to join the hunt.

feats.scene: Anureslis unfolds a shoulder cannon and levels a fortified bunker in one volley.
He stands in an artillery barrage with scorched plating and an unbroken grin.
He sprints across open mud faster than any soldier alongside him.

reply.summary: Tuman is a tiny talking monkey who rides along with a masked hero and a bumbling professor. He tumbles through trouble with a surprising talent for being exactly where a plan needs him.

feats.scene: Tuman yanks a lever with all his weight and drops a net on a pair of thieves.
He lands on a pavement from a lamppost and scampers off.

reply.summary: Nineonter is a white-haired archangel who guards the arts and cannot stand being told his work lacks weight. Exiled from the sky after a mortal's scheme, he sulks in a mortal city and keeps his wings folded.

feats.scene: Nineonter unfurls his wings and a pulse of white light flattens a row of tenement blocks.
He stands unmarked in the heart of a collapsing cathedral.
He crosses a harbour in the time it takes to clap.

reply.summary: Teiueru is an orphan who survived a cruel upbringing around fighting dogs and grew into a brute with claws and fangs. He hunts for an underworld syndicate and craves the approval of the one person who keeps him at arm's length.

feats.scene: Teiueru's claws rip an engine block out of a parked car.
He takes a brutal beating from a thug crew and still drags himself home.

reply.summary: Seirntia is a white-haired intelligence operative who reads minds in smoke-filled briefing rooms. Colleagues keep their thoughts blank around him, which he finds more revealing than any confession.

feats.scene: Seirntia pushes a stranger's will aside and walks him out of a locked office.
He is struck by a closing car door in a garage and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Titelti is a cartel enforcer who dresses as a flagellant monk and preaches that crime will be the order of the coming age. A hospital bed and a close brush with a poisoned drip have only hardened his faith.

feats.scene: Titelti swings a knotted scourge that splits a door panel.
He survives a gunshot wound and a night in intensive care.

reply.summary: Sttil is a zoologist who volunteered to be crossed with a quick weasel-like animal and now robs vaults at night. Her speed and cunning once won her a place beside a clown, until he left her stranded on a rooftop.

feats.scene: Sttil kicks open a reinforced vault grille after dodging the guards.
She races across a row of rooftops faster than a patrol car below.

reply.summary: Vallen is a gunwoman and killer for hire, raised among soldiers and humiliated by a father who ran a junta. Strength came late and she swore never to answer to anyone again.

feats.scene: Vallen hurls a jeep end over end into a squad of pursuers.
She takes a rocket blast on her forearm and keeps firing.

reply.summary: Ratiuan is a refugee teen who died and was rebuilt around a living light-engine, waking with a halo of coloured aura and no memories. Each recovered memory pulls them toward guilt and away from old friends.

feats.scene: Ratiuan bursts into radiant colour and burns a tunnel through a concrete bunker.
Their aura closes over a crushing blow and the damage fades in seconds.

reply.summary: Tesil is a young woman who was killed far from home and revived by an ancient being made of light, with every old memory wiped. Millions of years of cosmic patience sit uneasily inside a restless young body.

feats.scene: Tesil lets the light inside her pour out and wrecks a whole lakeside lodge.
She is thrown from a high bridge and glows brighter on the way down.

reply.summary: Seotel was a driver and a mother, remembered by her family as the steady hand behind two daughters and a quiet household. Her story is told only by the people she left behind.

feats.scene: Seotel stamps the brake and swerves a family car clear of a stalled truck.
She holds the wheel through a hard roadside bump with a sleeping child beside her.

reply.summary: Sateium is an overlooked company officer who grew bitter at never getting credit and began running elaborate crimes behind a mask. While his heroic rivals chased his schemes, he quietly emptied his own firm's accounts.

feats.scene: Sateium remotely sets a rigged warehouse robot loose to flatten a loading bay.
He survives a boardroom explosion by ducking behind a heavy oak desk.

reply.summary: Niorilas is an eight-year-old with braces and a pet goldfish, born wired into the living planet and perhaps its walking body. When the world turned stormy, she hid, was bound into an island and screamed for rescue.

feats.scene: Niorilas lets a continental storm front answer her fear and tears a coastline apart.
She is stretched into an island and holds together as a captor drains her.

reply.summary: Orrast is a patient classroom teacher at a city high school, known for staying late with struggling students. A passing crush on a masked neighbour never goes anywhere, and she finds contentment in her work.

feats.scene: Orrast slams a heavy classroom window shut against a gale.
She takes a fall on icy school steps and keeps teaching that day.

reply.summary: Ntetorres is a stranded alien whose power has no visible limit, bent by a cruel family into terrible deeds. He fled in shame, shut down into blank obedience, then woke and sailed home to mend his kin.

feats.scene: Ntetorres obeys a flat command and rewrites a whole mountain range into glass.
He takes a blow from his whole family at once and does not flinch.
He leaves orbit in a blink with his defeated relatives in tow.

reply.summary: Leolanam is a hulking artificial brute assembled from matter at the heart of the cosmos and driven to devour starlight. A starry mark on its brow is both its pride and its single weak point.

feats.scene: Leolanam punches through an avenue of towers and brings them down in dust.
It shrugs off a missile salvo that flattens a harbour district.

reply.summary: Riliunan is the purest knight of an old order, reborn centuries later as a warrior in a distant island nation. He guards his honour more tightly than his life and keeps looking for a worthy death.

feats.scene: Riliunan cleaves an armoured invader from shoulder to hip with one stroke.
He keeps fighting through a field of alien fire after his shield breaks.

reply.summary: Norantel is the ghost of a round-table knight, cursed long ago into an old axe after a family betrayal broke the fellowship. Without a body, he can only speak and strike through whoever lifts the blade.

feats.scene: Norantel guides a wielder's swing and splits an oak log in one blow.
The axe blade survives a rockfall that shatters the cellar floor.

reply.summary: Corresnia is a scholar of old chivalric tales who survived a ruined hospital and a burned city, then came to believe he is a legendary knight. Wandering a magical wood that heals mind and body, he fights off wolves and tends a wounded archer.

feats.scene: Corresnia drives off a snarling pack with a branch and bare fists.
He lifts fallen beams off the trapped and walks away bleeding but upright.

reply.summary: Catel is a lab-grown warrior made from a stranger's genes, built to be a weapon for her makers and burdened by borrowed dreams. When her makers lost control, she hunted anyone who knew of her.

feats.scene: Catel hurls a fireball from her eyes and brings down a concrete bridge span.
She walks out of an engineered explosion with torn clothes and a scowl.
She crosses a valley faster than sound.

reply.summary: Tumninva is a skiing-and-shooting champion turned elite sniper, calm under siege and loyal to her spotter. Together they cleared a rooftop of super-terrorists using borrowed hardware and clean shots.

feats.scene: Tumninva drops a sniper's bullet through a window across a plaza.
She sprints through a collapsing stairwell and walks out intact.

reply.summary: Nesies is a warrior priestess of a hidden island people, blessed with the strength of their gods. Turned into a cat to serve a goddess, she now guards a champion from the shadows with fangs and claws.

feats.scene: Nesies leaps from a rafter and bowls over a charging armoured guard.
She falls from a cliff face and lands on all fours.

reply.summary: Allst was a bald, brown-eyed ring bearer summoned to a troubled world to confront a rogue colleague. He died with the rest of his order, outmatched by a grief-driven killer.

feats.scene: Allst hurls a green lance that holes a hovering gunship.
His ring barrier buckles but does not break under a fierce volley.

reply.summary: Iltirium is a disciplined ring soldier of a space police corps, trained to tame fear with will. His glowing shapes are efficient and tidy, and he rarely wastes an effort.

feats.scene: Iltirium builds a giant glowing mallet and smashes a rebel barricade flat.
A luminous wall stops a fusillade of heavy bolts.

reply.summary: Erlenus is a lanky ring officer in a stylized cartoon cosmos, always the second to arrive and the first to salute. His willpower shapes sturdy glowing tools for any job.

feats.scene: Erlenus casts a glowing net over a falling satellite and slows it to a halt.
He shields himself from a power surge in a crackling glowing bubble.

reply.summary: Tause is a pink-skinned sea god from beyond the stars, a conqueror who calls the ocean to crush his foes. Long-lived and merciless, he serves a trio of deep rulers.

feats.scene: Tause drops a wall of water on a harbour town and drags it under.
He rises unharmed after a seaside fortress falls on him.

reply.summary: Orrumtor is a red-haired fence and broker who trusts her boss to be better than he seems. She wears layered armour and a rebreather, and does her fighting mostly with contracts and patience.

feats.scene: Orrumtor fires a pistol at a pursuer and drops him behind a crate.
Her armoured jacket stops a volley of slugs at the dock.

reply.summary: Ntitiltor is an orange-skinned, pointy-eared ring bearer from a far-future ocean world. He patrols a distant sector with quiet confidence, backed by a resolute will.

feats.scene: Ntitiltor launches a ring-forged harpoon and pins a smuggler's ship to a moon.
A radiant barrier shields him from a collapsing space dock.

reply.summary: Inullisti is a mob boss who rules his turf through threats and bounties and takes insults badly. He thought he could dismiss a stranger with painted scars, and paid for it.

feats.scene: Inullisti hits a debtor so hard that the man falls through a card table.
He takes a pipe across the shoulders and does not sway.

reply.summary: Inunen is a fair-haired sorceress cast out at birth for a bad omen, who returned to raise her homeland from the sea and demand obedience. Her spells turn followers into air-breathers and punish dissenters with suffocation.

feats.scene: Inunen heaves a whole sunken city up out of the waves in a roar of spray.
A rival's blast falls against her warding spell and splashes out harmlessly.

reply.summary: Anues is a late-night radio host who talks a city through dark hours with a warm voice and sharp taste in records. His quiet life takes him from studio to studio and out again.

feats.scene: Anues hauls a heavy crate of records up a flight of steps.
He slips on a wet curb and rises unhurt.

reply.summary: Lalan is a teenage bully who can split into three copies of herself, each acting alone but sharing sight and feeling. The weakness is plain, since knocking out one body drops all three.

feats.scene: Lalan has two copies pin a classmate while the third swings a locker door.
One copy takes a hard shove and all three stagger together.

reply.summary: Tollieo is a young city fighter who took up her uncle's masked identity to protect her neighbourhood. She wins by technique and grit rather than power.

feats.scene: Tollieo drops a mugger with a spinning kick to the jaw.
She takes a tumble down a fire escape and keeps running.

reply.summary: Stocescor is a yellow-skinned, heavyset alien from an ocean world whose people speak mind to mind. He overheard a hostile thought once and saved a whole team, which earned him his seat among them.

feats.scene: Stocescor pours a thought through a guard's head and sends him to sleep.
He takes a heavy stun beam and recovers within minutes.

reply.summary: Ninaucor is a small, wise elder of a cosmic order who later helped found a corps built on hope. His quiet patience steers younger hands, though he rarely lifts a hand himself.

feats.scene: Ninaucor raises one hand and a mountain of rock lifts out of the sea and hangs there.
He remains seated in a council chamber while it shakes itself apart.

reply.summary: Torlen is a white-haired cupbearer of a mountain-top court who pours the drink that grants endless life. A guest who refused his cup caused the loudest uproar the halls had heard in an age.

feats.scene: Torlen hurls a golden cup and cracks a marble pillar.
He stands in the middle of a thunderclap that shatters the hall's roof.

reply.summary: Serresrer is an alien who crash-landed in an old century and slowly became the iron-fisted ruler of a whole empire. His descendants spread across generations, and he cannot see why his cold rule is wrong.

feats.scene: Serresrer lifts a meeting hall off its foundations and carries it across the river.
He stands unscratched under a cannon barrage from a whole fleet.
He crosses a channel in the time it takes a rider to blink.

reply.summary: Nusselan is a red-haired sergeant who once worked for a government agency before switching sides to help a local team. He can turn unseen for a time and fights well hand to hand.

feats.scene: Nusselan vanishes and lands a hard blow on a guard from behind.
He takes a rifle butt to the ribs and carries on.

reply.summary: Aulliaul is a green-skinned young shapechanger from a darker timeline, a loyal teammate who trusted the wrong newcomer. His friends fall under a rain of rock, and he is left to ask how it happened.

feats.scene: Aulliaul becomes a rhino and charges through a brick wall.
He digs out from under a collapsed headquarters.
